sourceChecks.text: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がサウルの軍の長アブネルをネレの子、サウルのおじと紹介する。

sourceChecks.text: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がアブネルの父ネレをアビエルの子とする。

sourceChecks.text: When Saul saw David go out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the army, “Abner, whose son is this youth?” Abner said, “As your soul lives, O king, I can’t tell.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: サウルがアブネルにダビデの父を尋ね、アブネルは知らないと答える。

sourceChecks.text: As David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アブネルがペリシテ人を討ったダビデをサウルのもとへ連れて行く。

sourceChecks.text: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, even on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 宴席でアブネルがサウルのそばに座ったと記す。

sourceChecks.text: Then David arose and came to the place where Saul had encamped; and David saw the place where Saul lay, with Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his army. Saul lay within the place of the wagons, and the people were encamped around him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ダビデがサウルの陣を見て、軍の長アブネルを確認する。

sourceChecks.text: So David and Abishai came to the people by night; and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay around him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アブネルがサウルの周囲で人々とともに横たわっていたと記す。

sourceChecks.text: and David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, “Don’t you answer, Abner?” Then Abner answered, “Who are you who calls to the king?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ダビデがアブネルに呼びかけ、アブネルが応答する。

sourceChecks.text: David said to Abner, “Aren’t you a man? Who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not kept watch over your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ダビデがアブネルに王を守らなかったことを問いただす。

wikipediaArticleRead.noteJa: 記事はサウルのいとこでその軍の指揮官と説明し、ネレの子アブネルという名の形も挙げます。
